Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** (data period: May 2026).

This index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. A score of 1.0 is the global average, so Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population size alone would predict. That puts Japan **32nd of the 121 ranked countries**.

Compared with the global average:
- **Work, personal and coursework split:** work 47% (global 43%), personal 47% (global 40%), coursework 6% (global 16%).
- **Augmentation vs. automation:** augmentation (Claude helping with a task) is 53% (global 51%). Automation (Claude doing the task) is 47% (global 49%).

I only used the econ index tool. Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index

- Compare Japan with South Korea
